title: Fairy and Sorceress Ritual
description: A large iridescent fairy with multicolored wings and orange hair leans over a kneeling sorceress in a red and black dress. The sorceress places yellow flowers and orange slices onto a circular pattern of petals on the icy ground in front of a glowing purple magical archway, while a horned shadow figure watches from within the portal.
prompt: A mystical scene showing a large beautiful fairy with iridescent multicolored wings, purple skin and long flowing orange hair leaning down toward a sorceress in a flowing red and black dress with pink hair. The sorceress is kneeling on cracked ice placing yellow blossoms and orange slices into a ritual circle. Behind them is a glowing purple magical archway with a horned dark figure with red cape visible inside a swirling blue portal. Yellow flowering branches frame the scene, small spider-like creatures float nearby, in a vibrant fantasy style with luminous colors and intricate details.
